# LaneFlip

A neon‑styled endless runner where you flip lanes to dodge obstacles!

## How to Play
- Tap the left/right buttons or tilt your device to switch lanes.  
- Jump (tap space or swipe up) to avoid low barriers.  
- Keep running as far as you can—your score climbs with every meter.  
- Collect speed boosts for extra velocity and avoid collisions!

## Controls
- **Desktop**: Arrow keys or WASD to move, Space to jump.  
- **Mobile**: On‑screen buttons or device tilt.
